positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Cyral is a Series B startup ($41MM raised) building a unified data security governance platform.

I lead a team of engineers, head product design efforts, contribute to technical/architectural decisions, and do whatever else it takes to ship quality software at a sustainably high velocity.

I've also played a significant role in the field, engaging directly with enterprise and SMB customers to ensure successful product delivery.

projects.title: DjangoGirls Workshop
projects.description:
Hosted Santa Barbara’s first ever DjangoGirls event on Saturday, November 18th, 2017. The goal of the workshop was for participants who were unfamiliar with programming to get their feet wet and to do so by learning how to build a web application from scratch using a Python web development framework. To this end, we assembled a team of experienced coaches to guide attendees, who came with little to no prior coding experience, so they could leave the workshop having created and deployed personal blogs of their own.
I organized the event, helped train coaches, and lead the workshop.

projects.title: Spotilyzer
projects.description: Trained a classifier to identify songs as either jazz or not jazz given their audio features as input and achieved nearly 95% accuracy. In the process, our team created a python module to scrape the data from Spotify’s API and store it in a Postgres database.
